title: 依赖注入三种方式对比：构造器 / setter / 字段
expected_output:
=== constructor injection ===
  wired outside container  : user-7
  null dependency rejected at construction : repo must not be null

=== field injection ===
  before injection, repo is null : true
  calling it now throws NullPointerException (半初始化对象)
  after reflective injection      : user-7

=== setter injection ===
  before setter : NOT_INJECTED
  after setter  : user-7

=== comparison ===
  style          final?       container-free fail-fast on missing dep
  constructor    yes          yes            yes
  setter         no           yes            no
  field          no           no (needs reflection) no
